bio.text: Sara Hannan is a Democratic member of the Alaska House of Representatives for District 4, serving since 2019.

According to the Alaska Legislature's member page, Hannan holds a Bachelor of Education from the University of Alaska Fairbanks and taught social studies at Juneau-Douglas High School from 1996 to 2016.
The page also lists Hannan as co-owner of Alaska Wild Salmon from 2001 to 2019 and as an Alaska resident since 1962.
